title: Shape Resource
description: A generic, re-usable shape definition with no inherent meaning attached to it.

type.description: The type of shape this shape object represents. If any properties are explicitly specified for the shape, the shape properties object MUST match the shape type.

box.description: Parameter values defining a box shape.

capsule.description: Parameter values defining a capsule shape.

concave.description: A set of parameter values that are used to define a concave mesh shape.

convex.description: A set of parameter values that are used to define a convex hull mesh shape.

cylinder.description: Parameter values defining a cylinder shape.

plane.description: Parameter values defining a plane shape.

sphere.description: Parameter values defining a sphere shape.
